title: A callee's effects change; the unedited caller's diagnostics change with them
pins: The hard case for any per-file cache: the file whose diagnostics change is not the file that was edited. Cross-module effect enforcement (Calor0410) runs over cached effect summaries, so a stale summary would let the caller's violation vanish on a warm build. Step 2 reverses the edit, pinning the direction a cache is most likely to get wrong (appearing findings are noticed; disappearing ones are not).
reuseNote: The file set and options are constant, so the unedited caller stays a cache hit — which is the point: its cross-module violation has to surface from the cached effect summary.
